title: A concurrent edit between read and write is detected by stateVersion
manual: A real user edit needs the GUI (or a future test hook that runs an edit through the UI's action path, e.g. `_test_user_edit`). Scriptable stand-in: a second agent write plays the user. The detection logic under test (stateVersion compare, E_STALE) is the same.

all.contains: m2(1) v1 | A4:q B4:q C#5:q+ferm E5:q

questions: No write command's schema has expectStateVersion (only undo/redo in session.md). S17 assumes every write takes an optional expectStateVersion and refuses with E_STALE; this is a core (P2.1) decision.

Settled 2026-10-29 (P2.3): write_voice takes staff (1-based) and content as voice lines 'm<N> v<V> | ...' exactly as score_read prints them; validation problems are E_INVALID_ARG naming the bar and voice; an unknown staff is E_RANGE.
